text: Android: reduce background-sync interval toward ~5 min for timelier collaborator notifications

Implemented a self-rescheduling ~5-min one-time worker, then reverted at the user's request: WorkManager's periodic minimum is 15 min, and Doze/battery optimization batches background work when the device is idle anyway, so the ~5-min target gave little real benefit for more battery. Keeping the 15-min PeriodicWorkRequest.
